title: Paired early HARPS fits leave zero extraction difference compatible with the fixed GJ 3543 signal
abstract: We test extraction sensitivity of the known GJ 3543 velocity signal with HARPS-RVBank version 02. For 36 early visits at the fixed 9.161-day period, the DRS minus SERVAL sine fit has amplitude 0.834 m/s. The separate amplitudes are 3.249 and 3.501 m/s. A paired 10-day resampling rule gives an approximate 95 percent amplitude range of 0 to 1.918 m/s. One-day and 30-day rules also retain zero. Nightly zero point correction gives a difference of 0.818 m/s. Common weight, time, BERV, and H-alpha controls change the early point estimate little. These data do not resolve a difference between the extractions. Both products share spectra. A shared shift cancels even if it is an artifact, so this null result cannot confirm a planet or bound total contamination. Code, exact input, source hash, all fits, resamples, checks, and offline steps are included.

display.caption: Fixed-period coefficients and amplitudes from common HARPS visits. Gray points show paired 10-day resamples of early uncorrected extraction differences. The resampling range includes zero. Both extractions share spectra.
